title: Remove CGI and related dead-battery modules (PEP 594)
summary: Deprecate and remove cgi and other unmaintained standard library modules following PEP 594.
sourceTitle: PEP 594: Removing dead batteries from the standard library

alternatives.name: Retain cgi with community maintainers
alternatives.description: Keep cgi in the standard library but recruit external community maintainers.
alternatives.reason: Security vulnerabilities in multipart parsing and lack of active standard library maintainers.

evidence.quote: The cgi module has security liabilities and modern web frameworks have replaced it.
evidence.author: brettcannon

conditions.text: Requires modern multipart parsing outside the standard library

health.details: Modern alternative multipart parser package widely available on PyPI
health.interpretation: Constraint holds; ecosystem has transitioned to external packages.

decisionEvidence.quote: We have accepted PEP 594 and will proceed with deprecation in 3.11 and removal in 3.13.
decisionEvidence.author: steering-council

files.basis: Explicit file mention in deprecation discussion quote
